about: Every word on Study 86's page that is ours or the club's, by id (86.<slot>). x.* is shared; a.*, b.*, c.*, d.* belong to one option each (a Refraction, b Their Spectrum, c Hold It Up, d Their Light). build.cjs puts them on the page and writes copy.json. flag: draft = ours, italic; label = ours, wayfinding; sourced = the club's words verbatim (the workshop 2 board by element, the brand guide), see src, upright; chrome = the site's nav, footer, next. The club's home page is shown only as a picture (img/front.png), never transcribed. 'pending' holds what is never rendered until sourced.

quote.note: Every option: the client pride quote. Hidden until a verbatim founder line is supplied and cleared by Kahran.

tag.time.note: The tag's time for this part of the work alone.
